Plot a response curve

Source: R/plots.R
plot.mm_response_curve.Rd

Two stacked panels on a shared spend axis: the response and its marginal return. Spend beyond the observed range is shaded, because there the curve is extrapolation.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mm_response_curve'
plot(x, observed = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A data frame from response_curve().

observed

Optional numeric vector of the spend levels actually seen (for example the adstocked series); its range is left unshaded.

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

rc <- response_curve(seq(0, 6000, by = 100), coefficient = 6000,
                     half_max = 2250, shape = 1.6)
plot(rc, observed = c(0, 3450))
